Join Our Team

Grow with us.

It is so fun to be a part of a fast-growing fintech. You can jump right in and make an impact ? gaining experiences and growing your CV at the same time. When you join Covercy, you can work together as a team to crush our goals.

Why Covercy?

  • We believe embedded finance will change the way the world operates.
  • We live for our customers and we want to make investing in real estate easy for their customers.
  • We are the first real estate platform where banking meets investment management built specifically for Commercial Real Estate investment firms.
  • We hold and transfer millions of dollars. Every Day.
  • We would love for you to be a part of it.

Hear about Covercy from our CEO, Doron Cohen

Doron Cohen, CEO of Covercy, discusses company vision

Our Story

The Covercy story starts and stays with the customer. Founded in 2015, we wanted to solve cross-border payments which was a pain point in the marketplace. Paying attention to our customers, we noticed so many were in the Commercial Real Estate space. We spent time in the trenches learning about CRE and midway through 2020 we launched our Covercy GP platform which brings together banking and investment management all on one platform. Finally, investors, real estate and even payments all in one place. We are just getting started and we would love for you to be a part of it.

Banking services:

Covercy is a financial technology company and is not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided by Thread Bank, Member FDIC. FDIC deposit insurance covers the failure of an insured bank. Certain conditions must be satisfied for pass-through deposit insurance coverage to apply. The Covercy Visa debit card is issued by Thread Bank, Member FDIC, pursuant to a license from Visa U.S.A. Inc. and may be used anywhere Visa cards are accepted.

Your deposits qualify for up to $3,000,000 in FDIC insurance coverage when Thread Bank places them at program banks in its deposit sweep program. Your deposits at each program bank become eligible for FDIC insurance up to $250,000, inclusive of any other deposits you may already hold at the bank in the same ownership capacity. You can access the terms and conditions of the sweep program at https://thread.bank/sweep-disclosure/ and a list of program banks at https://thread.bank/program-banks/. Please contact customerservice@thread.bank with questions on the sweep program. Pass-through insurance coverage is subject to conditions.
